name: Moonglow Vest
summary: In Darnassus, Lotherias needs leather gear for young adventurers setting out across Kalimdor. She offers the pattern for a Moonglow Vest in return for shipments of embossed leather goods.

sections.title: Equipping the Kaldorei
sections.body: In Darnassus, leatherworkers work to outfit sentinels and young scouts. Night elves and allied wanderers leave Teldrassil for the wilds of Kalimdor, where sturdy armor is in demand. Lotherias is among the master leatherworkers supplying them with gear.

sections.title: Mastering the Craft
sections.body: Lotherias asks apprentices to bring matched embossed gloves, boots, and cloaks as proof of their skill. Those who meet her order earn her trust, and she teaches them a night elf pattern for the Moonglow Vest, made to protect while allowing free movement.

faq.answer: Lotherias is a night elf leatherworking trainer in Darnassus. She teaches the craft and offers advanced patterns to leatherworkers who prove their skill.

faq.q: Why does Lotherias need so many leather items?
faq.answer: Lotherias needs embossed leather gear to outfit young adventurers preparing to travel beyond Darnassus. She asks apprentices to supply the standard garments.
The Moonglow Vest is a leather armor pattern Lotherias teaches after you prove you can craft embossed goods in quantity.

faq.q: What materials are required to complete this task?
faq.answer: Bring Lotherias one pair of Embossed Leather Gloves, five pairs of Embossed Leather Boots, and five Embossed Leather Cloaks. You must craft each piece and deliver it to her.

faq.q: Can Horde leatherworkers learn this pattern here?
faq.answer: No. Lotherias trains Alliance craftspeople in Darnassus. Horde leatherworkers need to find trainers of their own across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Does this quest require a specific trade skill level?
aliases: when can i get moonglow vest
faq.answer: Yes. You need leatherworking proficiency of at least seventy before Lotherias will consider you skilled enough for the order and the vest pattern.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the fine leatherwork of Teldrassil in the Moonglow Vest, with its agile protection for scouts and sentinels beneath the forest canopy.
As an Alliance artisan, you help outfit new recruits in Darnassus, where the Alliance holds a fragile foothold in northern Kalimdor amid growing wild and hostile threats.
